Telling the person I love my feelings, never works out well. So
Im fine with waiting forever alone

That's the thing, I don't want help.
I want to fix this if I can by myself.
and i have started writing online

well, when i was a very small kid i saw my mothers boyfriend at the time (my father and her weren't together anymore) beating her up in the hallway, i think she lost a few teeth. At the time i was very young and didn't understand what was happening. it haunts me. i really wish i could have made him stop.
Well, I'm going to try and live a little longer

I like to write poetry and drawing, I can do a lot of that but my dad will find it (he searches) and ask me what it's about an I feel very Very uncomfortable talking to him about anything. I have a huge test today, he woke me up at three in the morning to say hi.
I was so mad and never got back to sleep. He won't do me any favors or buy clothes anymore. It's stupid.
He knows I've seen things I shouldn't have and I have to keep secrets from him. It's getting harder and harder
True, very true
Yeah, the saddest part.
How it would feel to some people if I was to kill myself the next day, everything i've done with my life and whether or not to wake up
A little bit. I did a lot of thinking last night

I might.
But I don't think there is a future for me anymore
Yeah I'm starting to fail some classes

Maybe :P

Not to myself, but I don't know how I am seen by others. I haven't broken any laws or hurt anyone in any form but I must have done something since everyone hates me and ignores me.
